description: This file contains unit tests for the DiGraph class in the OFBiz framework, verifying properties like acyclicity, cycle detection, and topological sorting using JUnit and Quickcheck.

classes.name: DiGraphTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the functionality of the DiGraph class, including cycle detection and topological sorting.

methods.name: testAcyclic
methods.description: Tests that a known acyclic graph is sorted correctly without exceptions.

methods.name: testWithCycle
methods.description: Ensures that graph with a cycle throws an IllegalStateException during sorting.

methods.name: testMultipleParents
methods.description: Tests graph with nodes having multiple parent nodes.

methods.name: topologicalOrderProperty
methods.description: Property-based test to verify topological order property for various graph specifications.

methods.name: checkTopologicalOrder
methods.description: Helper method to verify that the topological order of nodes respects dependencies.
